description: Make the API key a booking website needs. kind 'website': a server key (listings, availability, prices, holds, payments, reading a booking whose id it has). kind 'browser': a publishable key for web pages (the same, minus reading bookings). Neither can list bookings, see customers or change settings. Through the RatesSpot connector an owner approves it first (use check_approval; the key comes from there, once). The key is shown once: store it straight away.
name: create_website_key
title: Create a key for a booking website
